items.title: Norwegian Cruise Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Stock Down
items.summary: NCLH's second-quarter results reflect higher revenues, strong onboard spending and increased cruise capacity.

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Faces Soft Demand, Trims Guidance
items.summary: The less-optimistic outlook reflects softer booking patterns, related in part to the conflict in the Middle East but also to efforts to overhaul the company’s marketing and revenue management.  Norwegian said those factors will contribute to a nearly 5% decline in its net yield, suggesting that a more cost-conscious approach isn’t making up for the fact that ships aren’t filling with enough passengers.

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Q2 2026 earnings beat, cuts full-year outlook
items.summary: The cruise company topped its own adjusted EPS guidance of $0.38 with $0.48, but softer demand and rising fuel costs are weighing on the year ahead

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH) Q2 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
items.summary: Although the revenue and EPS for Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH) give a sense of how its business performed in the quarter ended June 2026, it might be worth considering how some key metrics compare with Wall Street estimates and the year-ago numbers.

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Shares Drop as Weaker Full-Year Outlook Overshadows Earnings Beat
items.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE:NCLH) reported second-quarter earnings that came in ahead of Wall Street expectations, but weaker full-year guidance disappointed investors and pushed the cruise operator’s shares lower in premarket trading.

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line (NYSE:NCLH) Posts Q2 CY2026 Sales In Line With Estimates But Stock Drops
items.summary: Cruise company Norwegian Cruise Line (NYSE:NCLH) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 4.9% year on year to $2.64 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.48 per share was 22.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
items.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +23.08% and +0.52%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line falls on weak guidance despite Q2 earnings beat
items.summary: Investing.com -- Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) reported second quarter results that exceeded profit expectations but issued disappointing full-year guidance, sending shares down 2% premarket following the announcement.
